help: the PR read first, then the standing forge report, then the acts, then the checkout's own state: an unresolvable argument, anything but MERGEABLE, or a closing set the forge computes as empty stops it before the report, refuse-class drift stops it before anything irreversible, the head is rebased onto the PR's own base and gated before it is force-pushed, the squash lands pinned to the head that rebase produced, this checkout converges on the merge commit the forge names, what the merge orphaned is swept by prune --apply, and the last word is the checkout's own state (git status) — no message flags, so the body is assembled from the branch's commits and keeps their signatures

args.name: pr
args.help: the PR to merge: a number, a URL, or a branch

gh pr view: reads the PR's base, head branch, mergeability and how many issues the forge will close for it, before anything else
reads its head again after the rebase, to pin the squash to what rebase produced
reads the merge commit after the squash, to converge this checkout on it
git fetch origin <base> <head>: reads both refs before the rebase
git push --force-with-lease: WRITES the rebased head back to the PR (refused loudly under YOGA_NO_SEND)
gh pr merge --squash: WRITES the merge (refused loudly under YOGA_NO_SEND)
git push origin --delete: prune --apply, sweeping the server branches this merge and its siblings left (refused loudly under YOGA_NO_SEND)
git fetch origin: reads the squash back so the base can fast-forward
